default/32241.htm.text: Berka: Huff... Huff... They should stop following now...

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/11-01.htm.text: Berka: Who's there! Reveal yourself at once! Ah, you're after this Resonance Amulet, too, aren't you? YOu can try to take it by force if you wish, but I warn you that I won't give it up so easily. You...you're... a Soul Breaker! Why are you here?

links.text: I saw you in the Tablet of Vision and came to see you.

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/11-02.htm.text: Berka: To get the Resonance Amulet, there are two ways. One way is to defeat the Archon of Halisha, who is located within the Four Sepulchers. you must form a party to enter. If that proves too difficult, defeat the followers of Halisha at the Shrine of Loyalty. By doing so, you can earn "tickets."…

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/11-03.htm.text: Berka: Aye, how time does fly! You have come for my Resonance Amulet, I suspect. My apologies for my bad manners just now; I was under attack when you appeared, and I assumed you were simply another enemy. My friend, I regret that you have come all this way -- I cannot give you this Resonance Amule…
